svg.title: Two enlarged cross-sections of one small hole through a flat pale oxide and a thin hatched film down to a thin purple pad, which stands on the top of a larger tungsten plug. Before the step the hole is open, with sloping walls. After it a thin purple film of even thickness covers the flat top, the walls and the floor of the hole.
svg.desc: Two enlarged cross-sections of one small hole through a flat pale oxide and a thin hatched film down to a thin purple pad, which stands on the top of a larger tungsten plug. Before the step the hole is open, with sloping walls. After it a thin purple film of even thickness covers the flat top, the walls and the floor of the hole.
svg.text: Titanium nitride is sputtered over the
wafer, into the holes and onto their floors.
After: the TiN liner in the hole and on the field
Close-up of the right-hand metal contact, enlarged
about 2.7×; the lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
